routes.title: DeepMol
routes.text: 01 / SEQUENCE GENERATION DeepMol CSVLoader → SMILES sequences → RNN MolecularGenerator Why: generate from molecules represented as SMILES sequences. Input: curated experimental SMILES loaded through DeepMol CSVLoader. Method: RNN MolecularGenerator. METHOD Recorded RNN run settings: 10 epochs; batch size 64. My work covered data loading, SMILES processing, and sequence-generation work. Learning: molecular representation shaped this route.

routes.title: RDKit + Fragmenstein
routes.text: 02 / FRAGMENT-BASED DESIGN RDKit + Fragmenstein Structure → Fragment selection → Recombination Why: explore structure-based design alongside sequence generation. Input: molecular structures and compatible fragments. Method: select, link, and recombine with RDKit / Fragmenstein. OUTCOME Some fragment workflows succeeded My work covered fragment selection, linking, and spatial workflows with RDKit / Fragmenstein. Learning: this route depends on structural fit and spatial context.

routes.title: REINVENT4
routes.text: 03 / ATTEMPTED GENERATION REINVENT4 REINVENT4 researched → Generation attempted Generation attempt did not succeed. OUTCOME No successful generation Why: test another generative approach alongside sequence and fragment work. I researched REINVENT4 and attempted generation. The available notes do not record its input, configuration, or why generation did not succeed. Learning: this remained an exploratory attempt, not a demonstrated generation workflow.
